**Finding: deviation (LOL-CAP)** — Section 7(a)–(b), paragraphs p0035/p0036.

- **Mutuality / consequential damages:** OK. 7(a) caps both parties and 7(b) waives lost profits and indirect/consequential damages mutually.
- **Cap basis fails fallback:** Contractor's cap is per-SOW, limited to fees actually *paid* for those particular Services on a time-and-materials engagement — potentially far below 12 months' fees, with no USD floor.
- **Carve-outs fail fallback:** The sole carve-out points to "Paragraph 9," which is the Independent Contractor/tax clause. There is no indemnification clause in the document at all (despite the Section 7 caption), and nothing carves out confidentiality (Section 8), gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, or infringement of Company IP — even though Contractor gives an unqualified non-infringement warranty at Section 5(c).

**Redline validated (ok:true):** mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000; existing Paragraph 9 carve-out preserved; our fee payment obligation expressly outside the cap; one new "Excluded Claims" sentence placing confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside all limitations. Fallback of a straight 12-month fee cap offered in the comment.
